ev.q: Estimates were based on weighted data for 347,597 ED visits for SR-related injuries
accounting for 5.1% of all SR-related ED visits
an estimated 207,830 patients with nonfatal SR-related TBIs were treated in EDs each year
Approximately 10.3% of patients with SR-related TBIs were hospitalized or transferred, compared with 3.1% of patients with SR-related injuries overall

methods_quotes.q: Confidence intervals were calculated using a direct variance estimation procedure that accounted for the sample weights and complex sample design
Each case was assigned a sample weight on the basis of the inverse probability of selection
Rates were calculated using averaged 2001--2005 U.S. Census bridged-race population estimates
